title: Canonical Zariski-etale Leray comparison from local vanishing of positive object cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], i its small Zariski to small etale functor with underlying scheme functor the open-restriction functor [def-sc-zariski-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and assume its continuity [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites]. Use the sheafified inverse image and continuous direct image with their adjunction [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let fstar be the cohomology pullback family characterized by naturality in the abelian sheaf, compatibility with connecting maps of short exact sequences, and evaluation of the unit in degree zero [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback]. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For each q>0, assume zero on the Zariski presheaf U->H^q(i(U),F) is locally injective: for any two sections s,t on U their equalizer sieve covers U [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective]. Then for every p>=0 and open V, fstar on H^p(V,i_*F) followed by H^p of the counit is an isomorphism to H^p(i(V),F). No strictly-henselian hypothesis is imposed. The Ext universe is arbitrary, and the sheafification assumptions are only those already needed for the coefficient sheaves.

proof.text: For the actual open-subscheme inclusion, inverse image on abelian sheaves is exact. The underlying-functor equality need not fix the structural map of i(top). Factor i through the etale object i(top), with underlying scheme X. The continuous direct image is restriction to this object followed by the usual Zariski direct image. Its left adjoint is the usual exact inverse image followed by exact etale extension by zero. Thus it is exact, and its right adjoint sends injectives to injectives.

Local injectivity of the zero endomorphism says s and 0 agree on a covering sieve. Hence the morphism of this presheaf to zero is locally injective and automatically locally surjective. To use sheafification, identify the arbitrary-universe Ext presheaf naturally with section-complex cohomology in a coefficient universe admitting sheafification. Transfer the local property through that natural isomorphism. The locally-bijective sheafification theorem makes its sheafification zero; sheafification preserves the zero object as an additive left adjoint.

By the higher-direct-image sheafification theorem, that sheafification is R^q i_*F. Thus all positive right derived direct images vanish. An injective resolution of F remains termwise injective after direct image, and has degree-zero homology i_*F by left exactness and no positive homology by vanishing. It is an injective resolution of i_*F. Evaluation on V downstairs is the same section complex as evaluation on i(V) upstairs, so it induces isomorphisms in every degree.

The resolution comparison representing cohomology pullback is natural in the coefficient sheaf and commutes with connecting maps. In degree zero it is evaluation of the unit, and composing with the counit gives the identity by the triangle identity. The uniqueness characterization of cohomology pullback in the three clauses hfstar identifies this resolution map with fstar, so the specified composite is the invertible comparison above. This identification, absent from the existential Lean conclusion of siteLeray_degenerate, is part of this bridge.

theorem zariski_etale_canonical_leray
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    (fstar : ∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
      (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      Sheaf.H' A p V ⟶
        Sheaf.H' ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj A)
          p (i.obj V))
    (hfstar : (∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (A A' : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : A ⟶ A'),
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) p).map φ).app
          (op V) ≫
            fstar p V A' =
          fstar p V A ≫
            ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology p).map
              ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map φ)).app
                  (op (i.obj V))) ∧
      (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (hS : S.ShortExact)
        (hS' : (S.map (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)).ShortExact)
        (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (x : Sheaf.H' S.X₃ p V),
        (fstar (p + 1) V S.X₁).hom (Abelian.Ext.comp x hS.extClass rfl) =
          Abelian.Ext.comp ((fstar p V S.X₃).hom x) hS'.extClass rfl) ∧
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (x : Sheaf.H' A 0 V),
        ((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ ((fstar 0 V A).hom x)).hom.app (op (i.obj V))).hom
            (((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
              (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op (i.obj V))).hom
                (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 (i.obj V)))) =
          (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).unit.app A).hom.app
              (op V)).hom
            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op V)).hom
              (((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
                  (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V))))))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hvan : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
        (0 : i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⟶
          i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q)) :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens), IsIso
      (fstar q V
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology q).map
          ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).counit.app F)).app
              (op (i.obj V)))
